articles.summary: Catherine Cambridge joins Docsum as Strategic Advisor, bringing 10+ years of in-house legal leadership experience. A former General Counsel and Chief Legal Officer, Catherine has led legal operations, procurement, and compliance teams, and will help Docsum build trust with legal teams adopting AI-powered contract intelligence.
articles.title: 🚀 Docsum Announces Catherine Cambridge as Strategic Advisor

articles.summary: Docsum’s latest product update introduces Entity Intelligence, advanced contract playbooks, Google Drive and SharePoint sync, AI-powered contract identification, and enterprise-grade access controls. Legal, finance, and operations teams can now automatically organize contract parties, sync agreements from cloud storage, streamline contract review in Microsoft Word, and control access at the view level—all from a single contract intelligence platform built for modern organizations.
articles.title: 🚀 Product Update: Entity Intelligence, Playbooks, Cloud Sync, and Enterprise Controls
